events.title: Sunset Boat Cruise — Nandoni Dam!
events.description: POAB x Piano Valley's Sunset Boat Cruise, Saturday 5 December at Nandoni Dam, Tshifaro Gardens. Includes the boat cruise, a pool side party and board games. Admit one R350, Transport R50. Call or WhatsApp 074 976 6649 or 063 687 9489 for tickets.
